set.body: Extract locus4s-core, locus4s-data, and locus4s-laws into /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/locus4s as a standalone JVM/Scala.js repository. Preserve package and artifact APIs, keep the artifact DAG acyclic, leave image4s-locus as the optional bridge, remove locus artifacts from the reframe4s default bundle, rewire local/immutable dependency coordinates, and prove standalone plus reframe4s/ScalaFIM consumers. Acceptance: standalone compileAll/testAll green; reframe4s compileAll/testAll and ownership/DAG gates green; original locus module directories removed only after parity; immutable publication remains separately explicit.
